title: Create round-trip fidelity test fixture diagrams
description: Create schema-valid JSON fixture diagrams covering edge cases for round-trip testing: composite primary keys, composite foreign keys, self-referencing relationships, unique constraints, indexes, nullable columns, default values, comments, and layout positions.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture set includes at least 5 schema-valid diagrams with varying complexity
Fixtures cover composite PK, composite FK, self-referencing relationships, unique constraints, indexes
Fixtures include tables with nullable columns, default values, comments, and layout x/y/width/height values
Each fixture validates against the canonical JSON Schema (Draft 7)
Fixture files are committed under test/fixtures/round-trip/

statusHistory.reason: Ticket created from PRD US-2.3 acceptance criterion (round-trip fidelity needs schema-valid fixtures)

evidence: test/fixtures/round-trip/composite-pk.json — composite PK (order_items: order_id+product_id), composite FK relationships, unique constraints, composite index, nullable columns, default values, comments, layout x/y/width/height
test/fixtures/round-trip/self-referencing.json — self-referencing FK (employees.manager_id -> employees.employee_id), circular FK (departments<->employees), nullable FK columns
test/fixtures/round-trip/unique-constraints-indexes.json — single + composite unique constraints, single + composite indexes
test/fixtures/round-trip/complex-enterprise.json — 4 tables, 6 relationships, 3 UCs, 5 indexes, all features combined
test/fixtures/round-trip/edge-cases.json — nullable columns, default values, comments, boolean/timestamp/date types

src/__tests__/round-trip-fixtures.test.ts — 21 tests: JSON Schema Draft 7 validation (ajv), serialize/deserialize round-trip fidelity, edge case coverage (composite PK, composite FK, self-referencing, unique constraints, indexes, nullable, defaults, comments, layout). All 21 tests pass.
src/serialization/diagramSerializer.ts — fixed serializeIndex to preserve unique flag (was hardcoded false)
src/serialization/diagramDeserializer.ts — fixed deserializeColumn to preserve length/unique/comment; fixed deserializeIndex to preserve unique
src/types/diagram.ts — added unique?: boolean to Index type
package.json — added ajv devDependency for JSON Schema validation
Full vitest suite: 445 tests passed across 33 test files (run in Docker via node:20-alpine container)

Docker test command: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v $(pwd):/work:rw -v $(pwd)/qa-artifacts:/artifacts -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c "npm test"
